about: Intentional uses of "Gaia" in customer-facing copy that must NOT become "Gaia Healers". Read by scripts/brand-audit.mjs and enforced by tests/brand-consistency.test.cjs. Each pattern is a JavaScript regex; an occurrence is allowed only when a match of the pattern covers that very "Gaia". Keep patterns as narrow as the phrase they protect; prefer adding a phrase here over widening an existing one. Rule for the assistant: the AI assistant's product name is "Gaia Assist" and its character is addressed as "Gaia" (Ask Gaia, Talk to Gaia, Gaia is thinking…). The character keeps "Gaia"; every reference to the company, platform, app, website, account, profile, team or catalogue is "Gaia Healers".
